steps: Remove the tank lid and flush to observe the flapper and fill valve.
Check chain slack on the flapper - adjust so it has slight slack when closed.
If the flapper is worn/warped, replace it with a matching universal flapper.
If water still runs, the fill valve may need replacing.
Turn water back on and flush several times to confirm it stops running.
